description: This Java class configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for a Spring Boot backend. It sets up allowed origins, methods, headers, and other CORS policies for API endpoints to enable browser clients (such as a React frontend) to communicate securely across different origins.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that implements WebMvcConfigurer to customize CORS mappings for the API endpoints.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the default method to configure CORS settings dynamically based on environment variables or default values.
